resources.note: Given as a user message labelled as information, not instructions. Only inline text/plain and application/json sources are read; URI sources are refused.

model.name.note: The model must be in the catalogue of a configured provider of type openai, ollama or lmstudio; the catalogue is read from the user's providers at launch.

model.effort.note: Sent as the provider's reasoning effort; when the provider rejects the effort or the parameter, Macro retries the request without an effort.

skills.note: The resident agent has no skill tool and refuses URI content, so SKILL.md skills cannot be shown or loaded on demand.

mcpServers.note: The resident agent only receives qualified Macro workspace tools; MCP tools are excluded from its profile.

plan.note: The resident agent has no plan or todo tool.

planFirst.auto.note: The resident agent has no plan mode.

planFirst.ask.note: The resident agent has no plan mode.

instance.new.note: Macro creates one instance per agent definition per flow run and keeps its memory; it cannot create a fresh instance per work.

delivery.steer.note: Steering steps are refused and each instance processes its works one at a time in FIFO order.

reviewer.person.note: Macro cannot apply an ask rule; it asks a person according to its own tool risk level.

reviewer.model.note: Macro cannot apply an ask rule; it asks a person according to its own tool risk level.

directories.note: The resident agent works in a single workspace root.

read.note: Read tools (list, read, glob, grep, ast_grep, git inspection) act only inside the workspace root; paths outside it are denied. Macro always allows read tools inside the workspace and cannot apply path rules there.

write.note: Write tools (write, edit, delete, apply_patch) act only inside the workspace root and are removed for read-only projects and in Chat mode. Macro cannot apply document path rules, so a write deny is not enforced as AgSDL requires, and it asks according to its own risk level.

shell.note: The resident agent has no terminal tool; any tool outside its captured workspace tools is refused.

network.note: The resident agent has no web or network tool; any tool outside its captured workspace tools is refused.

mcp.note: MCP tools are not offered to the resident agent; any tool outside its captured workspace tools is refused.

delegate.note: The resident agent cannot start sub-agents; any tool outside its captured workspace tools is refused.

providerId.description: Identifier of the configured Macro provider that serves the model.

mode.description: Macro tool mode. Default: Implement. Chat gives the agent no workspace tools; Architect limits writes to Macro metadata files.

maxTurns.description: Maximum model turns per work; a positive integer.
